sights.n: Sun World Ba Đen Mountain Cable Car
sights.address: Sun World Ba Den Mountain, Núi Bà Đen, Tây Ninh, Vietnam
sights.w: The Doppelmayr cable-car complex that lifts you up the 986 m 'Roof of the South' in minutes instead of a three-hour climb. Its Ba Den departure station holds the Guinness World Record for the largest cable-car station (10,959 sqm), moving 4,400 passengers an hour to the spiritual complex on top.

sights.n: Tây Bổ Đà Sơn Buddha Statue
sights.address: Summit of Núi Bà Đen, Tây Ninh, Vietnam
sights.w: A 72 m bronze Bodhisattva cast from 170+ tonnes of red copper on the 986 m summit — recognised by Guinness as Asia's tallest bronze Lady-Buddha statue on a mountain peak. Ringed by terraced gardens and often wrapped in cloud, it is the visual icon of the Bà Đen complex.

sights.n: Ma Thiên Lãnh Valley & Núi Đá Lake
sights.address: Thạnh Tân, Tây Ninh (Ma Thiên Lãnh), Vietnam
sights.w: A cool green valley cradled between Bà Đen, Núi Heo and Núi Phụng, nicknamed 'the Đà Lạt of the Southeast'. Its emerald Núi Đá Lake — a flooded former limestone quarry ringed by primeval forest — is the region's favourite camping, BBQ and photo spot.

Vietnam and Southeast Asia's largest artificial lake — 270 sqkm damming the upper Saigon River, completed 1985 — now an ecotourism draw of forested islets and hill-fringed water. A go-to for camping, fishing and sunset-watching on the far side of Bà Đen.

sights.address: Long Hoa, Hòa Thành, Tây Ninh, Vietnam
sights.w: Tây Ninh's busiest market, laid out in 1952 to the design of Cao Đài dignitary Phạm Công Tắc to serve the faith's followers. The place to buy the province's edible souvenirs — dew-soaked rice paper, muối tôm, sesame and beans — and to eat at its famous vegetarian stalls.

sights.n: Cu Chi Wildlife Rescue Station — CLOSED
sights.address: Tỉnh lộ 15, between Bến Đình & Bến Dược, Củ Chi, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: An NGO-run rescue centre (founded 2006, Wildlife at Risk) between the two tunnel sites that rehabilitated 4,000+ trafficked animals — pangolins, bears, otters, gibbons, langurs — with a public education display. Now closed to visitors indefinitely; listed for reference.

sights.address: 78 Sông Lu, Trung An, Củ Chi, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A cluster of pick-your-own orchards 30 km out in Trung An commune — rambutan, mangosteen, jackfruit and durian in season — where a small entry fee lets you eat fruit off the tree and try Củ Chi country snacks. A relaxed rural add-on to the tunnels.
